Amazon deal pricing on AirPods Pro 3 has now dropped a touch lower at a solid $50 off and it is still offering the pre-order discount on the new Apple TV 4K, however we are also tracking some deals on Apple’s iPhone duo-ready accessories like the 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max and Apple Pencil USB-C. Those offers join 24GB M5 MacBook Air returning to its best price in months at $200 off, the lowest price ever for a single AirTag 2, and the first cash discount on the new all-new modular Beats 360 over-ear headphones (the Cushion Kits are still up to 80% off too). Everything awaits below, alongside some charging gear deals like the Belkin Qi2.2 25W UltraCharge 2-in-1 Foldable Charging Station down at $50.

New M6 MacBook Pro, OLED iPad mini, and more now available for pre-order:

  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,999
  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,199
  • 14-inch M6 MacBook Pro 32GB/1TB $2,399
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display $2,899
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display $3,399

Amazon’s AirPods Pro 3 deal is back at over 20% off

We have had an extended run of deals on Apple’s best earbuds lately, and after jumping back up closer to full price yesterday, Amazon has decided to keep the ball rolling with a solid20% discount on AirPods Pro 3.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 down at $199.99 shipped. That’s actually $1 more than they were through last week, but we are still talking about a solid 20% discount here at nearly $50 off the list price.

Major 45% price drop hits AirPods 4 with ANC at $99 today, but AirPods 5 are only $29 more

Alongside the current AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off, one of today’s featured deals at Woot delivers AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation down at $99 shipped. That’s a sizable 45% price drop on the previous-generation buds and easily one of the best prices ever, but you can score the new AirPods 5 with ANC from $129.

Woot is now offering Apple’s AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation down at $99 with free shipping for Prime members (a $6 delivery fee will apply otherwise).

AirPods 4 with ANC carried a $179 list price before being replaced by the AirPods 5 lineup this past September. Today’s deal is 45% off the original list price and one of the best deals we have tracked on the buds to date – the Woot listing is in brand new condition, but it ships with a 90-day Woot warranty.

This is matching last year’s particularly popular and extremely notable Amazon Black Friday price, but the new AirPods 5 are available now and you can score the entry-level set that also happens to include ANC this time around for just $29 more.

It’s not quite that simple though. The AirPods 4 with ANC also include a wireless charging case, and you’ll need to bump up to the higher-end AirPods 5 at $149 to score one of those.

  • AirPods 4 with ANC $99 (Orig. $179)
  • AirPods 5 with ANC $129
  • AirPods 5 with ANC and Wireless Charging Case $149
  • AirPods Pro 3 $199 (Reg. $249)

I would just splurge or save up for AirPods Pro 3 at $199 instead, but if that’s not an option or you just prefer the standard Pods vibe, the decision is perhaps little more of a thing. Woot deal is certainly a notable one. And if you really want that wireless charging case, you are keeping $50 in your pocket over paying full price for the higher-end AirPods 5 here, but you’re also not getting the proper Apple warranty going with the Woot listing. As enticing as 45% off a pair of AirPods is, if I was going with the standard AirPods lineup, I’d go for the proper warranty at $29 more

Don’t pay full price to fast charge iPhone Duo with Apple’s Dynamic Power Adapter, Amazon has it for less

The iPhone Duo is out there now and Apple specifically recommends you use its 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max to fast charge the new foldable. Just don’t buy one direct, you can get it for less on Amazon right now.

Amazon is offering the official Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max down at $34.99 with free shipping for Prime members or in orders over $35. That’s not a massive deal considering you can score one straight from Apple at $39 any day of the week. But with iPhone Duo out in the wild now and Apple recommending this model for fast charging, we just wanted to make sure folks knew it can be had for less on Amazon.

We did see this one selling for around $27 on Amazon a few times earlier in the year, but it has found new life for some Duo users and it’s hard to say if, or when, it will ever drop any lower in the near future because of it.

It, like the Apple Pencil (USB-C), has started to see a sudden (but not so surprising) surge in popularity among 9to5 readers looking to optimize and elevate the iPhone Duo experience, and you might as well keep a few bucks in your pocket if you’re going to pick one up.

iPhone Duo users clearing out Apple Pencil (USB-C) at Apple Store, score one from $59 on Amazon instead

The iPhone Duo is here and if you’re still looking to elevate the experience with Apple Pencil, the only compatible model is the USB-C variant and you can land one at Amazon down at $69 right now. More than a couple staffers have been reporting little to no stock availability at local Apple brick and mortar locations, so we just wanted to touch base to ensure folks know you can easily grab one at Amazon with relatively speedy delivery still and at a lower price – there are even Amazon Resale units at $60 right now.

Apple’s 24GB M5 MacBook Air just returned to its best price in months at $200 off

While the less pricey 16GB/1TB model is still at $200 off, Amazon just brought back its fall Prime Day price on the upgraded 24GB MacBook Air at $200 off as well.

Amazon is once again offering Apple’s 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB of RAM and the 1TB storage capacity down at $1,599 shipped.

This is a regularly $1,799 configuration that is now $200 off the list price to deliver the lowest we can find online.

We did spot this same deal over the weekend on all four colors, but it quickly disappeared on all of them. While only the Midnight has returned here this afternoon, we are talking about a deal on par with the fall Prime Day price and matching the lowest we have tracked in months.

Amazon’s single AirTag 2 listing just hit its lowest price ever at $23, more

Amazon’s 2026 Apple TV 4K pre-order discount is still live

Unlike the new Apple HomeView, it looks like Amazon is actually going to be holding on to the early pre-order discount on the new Apple TV 4K for now. But you might want to get in there sooner than later before the delivery times slip even further.

As of the time of writing, Amazon is still delivering the brand new Apple TV 4K down at $289.99 shipped.

  • NEW Apple TV 4K $289 (Reg. $299)

First deal hits new modular Beats 360 headphones today + Cushion Kits still 80% off

Back in September Apple’s Beats brands launched the all-new modular Beats 360 over-ear headphones and today we are catching the very first straight up cash discount on the headphones themselves. Amazon is still also offering the deep 80% launch discount on the interchangeable Cushion Kits.

Amazon is now offering the new black model Beats 360 Over-Ear Headphones down at $329 shipped – the Cloud white colorway is still up at full price.

  • Beats 360 Over-Ear Headphones $329 (Reg. $350)
  • Beats 360 Cushion Kit $10 (Reg. $50)

That’s certainly not a massive discount at just $20 off, but it is the very first chance at any savings at all and we wanted to make sure it was on the radar for the remaining early adopters while the Cushion Kits were still on sale as well.

The Beats 360 feature modular a headband cushion and earpads – you can flip them out/mix and match with any of the official Cushion Kits. These kits carry $50 list prices but Amazon and Beats offered a launch deal on them at 80% off and some of them are still down at just $9.99 apiece.

For a complete rundown on the new Beats 360, head over to our hands-on review right here.

Apple Watch Series 10/11 clearance deals up to nearly $200 off

Score Belkin’s foldable 25W MagSafe charging station down at $50 today (All colors)

Belkin makes a super clean and minimalist Qi2.2 25W Wireless 2-in-1 foldable charging station and it has now dropped back down to $50 in all three colors.

Amazon is now offering the Belkin Qi2.2 25W UltraCharge 2-in-1 Foldable Charging Station down at $49.99 shipped. This deal price is live on the black, white, and blue colorways.

Regularly $60, deals on this model have largely been hard to come by up until the last month or so. We have seen a couple Prime Day discounts dropping as low as $43, but the deal we have here today is on par with the lowest we have tracked otherwise, coming within $7 of the Amazon all-time low.

As I have said previously, Anker actually makes my favorite foldable MagSafe charging station – the 3-in-1 Prime model you can currently score on sale at $35% off right now. But if you only need a 2-in-1 setup for iPhone and AirPods, this Belkin model is a solid choice and one you can lock in for half the price right now.

Transform your old Apple Watch into a retro-inspired handheld [Deal]

The TechPod RePod has to be one of the more compelling ways to repurpose your old Apple Watch. For around $50 with the Amazon deals right now, these things effectively bring your Apple Watch back to life, transforming it into a functional and retro-inspired handheld.

While not all models are discounted on the brand’s Amazon storefront, they do all carry a $60 list and many of them have on page coupons to knock the price down to $50.99 shipped right now. You can also save an extra 5% if you purchase two of them.

  • RePod C1 for Apple Watch $50.99 (Reg. $60)

There are RePod sizes to support just about all previous-generation Apple Watch models, going right back to Series 4, through the SE models, and right up through to Series 10 and 11. They might be one of, if not, the most interesting way to bring your old Apple wearable back to life I have seen yet.

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Hohem’s V3 Ultra AI gimbal with detachable live-preview remote returns to $110 low (Today only)
  • Just $13 today gets you ESR’s 3-in-1 charger for your iPhone, AirPods, and Apple Watch
  • Score a pair of Beats USB-C Woven Cables at just $7 each (60% off orig. price)
  • JBL’s Live Buds 3 ANC earbuds with touchscreen case just plunged 54% to hit $92 all-time low
  • Baseus 100W mini display USB-C Cable down at $9 with this code

Twelve South unveils next-gen Airfly View with built-in display

Just after the reveal of its new AirFly Drive CarPlay and Android Auto wireless adapter for your ride, today Twelve South is ready to upgrade your audio experience in the air. Ready to connect directly to the in-flight entertainment system, the all-new Airfly View adds a built-in display to what was already the one of, if not, the best wireless audio transmitters for your wireless buds and headphones.

Twelve South unveils new Airfly View

Anyone familiar with the previous Airfly transmitters is going to be right at home here again. A staple in packing lists and best of travel accessory guides for years now, Twelve South is bringing its Airfly into the next-generation with the same level of simplicity, but with a new built-in display so you can actually see what’s going on.

Airfly started with one narrow problem: wireless headphones, and the wired jacks still bolted into airplane seatbacks, gym treadmills, and older cars. It has been solving that simply ever since. Airfly View keeps the same simplicity and puts every step on screen.

Airfly View is available starting today in Black and Coastal blue with an included international airline adapter and zippered hard-shell travel case at $79.99.

Twelve South Airfly Drive CarPlay and Android Auto wireless adapter has been one of the more popular tech releases around here over the last month or so, and it’s back. Shipping times started to slip well into December on the popular black model, but Amazon is now listing both it and the white for delivery as soon as next week.

  • Twelve South Airfly Drive (Black) $40 | Nov. 2 – 4
  • Twelve South Airfly Drive (White) $40 | Nov. 1
